Name: Valley Buddies - Living NPC Companions and Farmhands
Author: Juxxan3
Description:
[b]🌟 VALLEY BUDDIES (Stardew Valley 1.6+ | SMAPI 4.0+)[/b]
[b][i]Bring Pelican Town villagers to physical life: companions, farmhands, cozy evenings, camping, and sleepovers![/i][/b]
[b]Version:[/b] 2.0
[b]Author:[/b] Juxxan3
[b]Nexus Mods Category:[/b] NPCs / Companions / Gameplay / Farm Mechanics
[line]
[heading][b]⚡ WHAT'S NEW IN VERSION 2.0? (THE STANDALONE & NIGHTLIFE EVOLUTION)[/b][/heading]
[list]
[*]🚀 [b]Dual Architecture (Standalone or AI-Integrated):[/b] AliveNpcs is [b]NO LONGER MANDATORY[/b]! Valley Buddies can now run 100% on its own as a standalone companion mod with native recruitment, or seamlessly link with AliveNpcs if installed.[/*]
[*]🌙 [b]Complete Nightlife & Bed Sleepovers:[/b] Villagers can pitch a tent & campfire outdoors, explore your home (chimneys, bookshelves, windows, kitchens), tuck under the covers of Single and Double beds with genuine sleep animations and periodic
[code]Zzz[/code]emotes![/*]
[*]☕ [b]Repeatable Sleepover Coffee Letters:[/b] Wake up to a sweet morning letter in your mailbox containing fresh coffee (
[code](O)395[/code]) after every sleepover![/*]
[*]⌨️ [b]Quick Recruitment Hotkey:[/b] Press
[code]LeftShift + E (Please check this, its important)[/code]near any eligible villager to invite them or open their action hub instantly.[/*]
[*]🛡️ [b]Shop Duty & Schedule Protection:[/b] Villagers won't abandon their work shifts (Pierre, Marnie, Clint, etc. protect their store counters during business hours), and vanilla schedules won't hijack companions.[/*]
[*]🌾 [b]Strict 1x Resource Gathering & Anti-Stuck Warps:[/b] Fully tuned pathfinding with zero duplications and anti-stuck BFS spawns across map transitions.[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading][b]⚠️ REQUIREMENTS & COMPATIBILITY[/b][/heading]
[list=1]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b] (fully compatible with 1.6.9, 1.6.14, and 1.6.16+).[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/b].[/*]
[*][b][Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)]:[/b] [i](Highly Recommended)[/i] Configure hotkeys, force offline mode, adjust chore radiuses, toggle sleepover letters, and manage companion behaviors in-game with a clean visual UI. [/*]
[/list][b]🧩 Optional (Choose Your Playstyle):[/b]
[list]
[*][b][AliveNpcs] (by Lucas):[/b] [i](Optional)[/i] If installed, Valley Buddies automatically connects to provide dynamic AI conversation generation and memory feeding. If not installed, Valley Buddies operates seamlessly in [b]Offline Standalone Mode[/b]![/*]
[/list][line]
[heading][b]📖 WHAT IS VALLEY BUDDIES?[/b][/heading]
Ever wished that villagers weren't just static portraits? When an NPC says [i]"Let me help you on the farm!"[/i] or [i]"Let's go explore the woods!"[/i], shouldn't they actually walk with you and do it?
[b]Valley Buddies[/b] gives villagers [b]real physical agency in the Stardew Valley world[/b]. Whether you play with or without external AI dialogue mods, your friends will physically follow you, perform farm chores, relax in your home, camp under the stars, fight in the mines, and sleep over!
[line]
[heading][b]✨ KEY FEATURES[/b][/heading]
[b]🌾 1. Real Farmhand Assistance[/b]
Companions are active helpers who work right by your side:
[list]
[*][b]Smart Watering:[/b] Waters tilled crops (
[code]HoeDirt[/code]), farmhouse flower pots (
[code]IndoorPot[/code]), and refills your pet's water bowl.[/*]
[*][b]Lumberjack & Direct Delivery:[/b] Chops branches, debris, and trees, delivering wood and sap directly into your hands (1x exact yield) or neatly storing them in your nearest chest.[/*]
[*][b]Petting Farm Animals:[/b] Walks over to your cows, chickens, ducks, and sheep to pet them. Hearts appear over animals and real daily friendship points are awarded![/*]
[*][b]Mining & Clearing:[/b] Breaks rocks and weeds around your farmland.[/*]
[*][b]Harvesting & Foraging:[/b] Gathers ripe crops and wild seasonal forage.[/*]
[/list][b]🏡 2. Organic Nightlife & Sleepovers (Past 6:00 PM)[/b]
When night falls and you enter your farmhouse or cabin:
[list]
[*][b]Living Home Routine:[/b] Companions explore your home autonomously—warming up by the lit fireplace, gazing out rainy windows, checking bookshelves, relaxing on chairs, visiting the kitchen, or playing with pets.[/*]
[*][b]Tucked-in Bed Rest:[/b] At 11:00 PM (or whenever the farmer goes to bed), your guest finds an available Single or Double bed, aligns under the blanket covers, plays their sleep animation, and drifts off with floating
[code]Zzz[/code]emotes.[/*]
[*][b]Campfire & Tent Under the Stars:[/b] If outdoors late at night, light a temporary campfire and pitch a tent together to watch the constellations![/*]
[*][b]Morning Coffee Mail:[/b] Check your mailbox the next morning for a personalized thank-you note and fresh coffee![/*]
[/list][b]🚶 3. Natural Navigation & Physics[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Human-like Pathfinding:[/b] Decelerates indoors to avoid clipping, turns corners cleanly, and respects your personal space with smooth distance hysteresis (~2.7 to 3.3 tiles).[/*]
[*][b]Auto-Gate Opening:[/b] Automatically opens and closes fence gates within a 1.5 tile radius.[/*]
[*][b]Anti-Stuck Map Warps:[/b] Built-in BFS connectivity scan guarantees companions spawn on safe, walkable tiles when transitioning between maps (e.g., entering the Farm from Bus Stop or Forest).[/*]
[/list][b]⚔️ 4. Mine Expeditions & Social Hangouts[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Combat Support:[/b] Accompanies you into the Mines, Skull Cavern, and Volcano Dungeon, granting support auras.[/*]
[*][b]Social Hangouts:[/b] Enjoy outdoor picnics, play music together, dance under the trees, stargaze, or share a warm hug.[/*]
[*][b]Daily Talk Count:[/b] Interacting with your companion counts toward your daily conversation limit (+20 friendship points).[/*]
[/list][b]👥 5. Full Multiplayer Synchronization (Host & Farmhands)[/b]
[list]
[*]Built from the ground up for co-op! Both Host and Farmhands can have active companions without desyncs, overlapping orders, or lost jobs.[/*]
[/list][heading][b]🎮 CONTROLS & HOW TO RECRUIT[/b][/heading]
[list=1]
[*][b]Quick Recruit / Action Hotkey:[/b] Stand near any villager and press
[code]LeftShift + E[/code](rebindable in GMCM).
[list]
[*]If they aren't recruited yet, this triggers an invitation prompt.[/*]
[*]If they are already following or visiting, it opens the [b]Companion Action Menu[/b] (Follow, Farm Help, Social, Camp/Sleep, Dismiss).[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Post-Dialogue Invite Prompt:[/b] In Standalone mode, talking to an eligible villager automatically brings up a natural post-dialogue prompt asking if you'd like them to join you for the day.[/*]
[*][b]Right-Click Interaction:[/b] Right-click on your companion at any time to open their action menu.[/*]
[*][b]Quick Dismiss Key:[/b] Press
[code]End[/code](default) to dismiss your follower and allow them to wave goodbye and resume their routine.[/*]
[/list][heading][b]🌐 FULLY TRANSLATED INTO 11 LANGUAGES[/b][/heading]
Valley Buddies automatically matches your Stardew Valley language setting (425 keys per language):
[list]
[*]🇺🇸 [b]English[/b] (
[code]default.json[/code][code]en.json[/code][/*]
[*]🇪🇸 [b]Español / Spanish[/b] (
[code]es.json[/code][/*]
[*]🇧🇷 [b]Português do Brasil / Brazilian Portuguese[/b] (
[code]pt.json[/code][/*]
[*]🇨🇳 [b]简体中文 / Simplified Chinese[/b] (
[code]zh.json[/code][/*]
[*]🇷🇺 [b]Русский / Russian[/b] (
[code]ru.json[/code][/*]
[*]🇩🇪 [b]Deutsch / German[/b] (
[code]de.json[/code][/*]
[*]🇫🇷 [b]Français / French[/b] (
[code]fr.json[/code][/*]
[*]🇯🇵 [b]日本語 / Japanese[/b] (
[code]ja.json[/code][/*]
[*]🇰🇷 [b]한국어 / Korean[/b] (
[code]ko.json[/code][/*]
[*]🇮🇹 [b]Italiano / Italian[/b] (
[code]it.json[/code][/*]
[/list][heading][b]❤️ CREDITS & ACKNOWLEDGMENTS[/b][/heading]
